a11y.notes: Renders a semantic element (p, span, div, label, dt, dd, or li) chosen by `as`; `dt` and `dd` need a `dl` parent and `li` a `ul` or `ol` parent, forwards `ref`, and inherits the design-system foreground contrast tokens. Use `tone="muted"` on the default `background`, because on `muted` or `card` surfaces the muted foreground can fall below WCAG AA. For a real form label use the Label component, which wires the htmlFor association.
